title: Ọnwụnwa ahụ n'okpuru ebili mmiri
intro: Otu onye amụma, onye ọrụ ya na-ebu ibu arọ, mere mkpebi nke dugara ya n'ebe dị anya site n'aka ndị ya ma banye n'ọnwụnwa a na-atụghị anya ya. Njem ya gbanwere nke ukwuu, na-anwale okwukwe na ndidi ya n'ụzọ kachasị omimi. Ị nwere ike ịchọpụta nkọwa nke ihe omume a pụrụ iche site na ihe ndị enyere?
clues: E zigara otu onye amụma nye ndị mmadụ, mana ọ lara ngwa ngwa, na-enwe nkụda mmụọ maka ịjụ ha.
Njem ya dugara ya n'oké osimiri, ebe ọ banyere n'ụgbọ mmiri buru ibu nke na-achọ ụzọ ọ ga-esi agafe.
Oké ifufe malitere, nke mere ka ụgbọ mmiri ahụ yie ihe egwu, e wee kpebie ịtụba otu onye n'ime mmiri iji mee ka ibu ahụ dị mfe, nke e kpebiri site n'itinye nza.
E ji ihe dị n'ime mmiri loda ya, ihe dị ebube nke uche Chineke nyere iwu.
N'ime afọ ihe e kere eke ahụ, ọ kpọkuru Onyenwe ya, na-echegharị ma na-eto Allah n'ọchịchịrị.
Mgbe o kpesịrị ekpere siri ike ruo oge ụfọdụ, a tụbara ya n'ụsọ oké osimiri tọgbọrọ chakoo, ike adịghị ya mana ọ dị ndụ, ma mesịa lọghachi wee chọpụta na ndị ya ekwenyela.

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: Ọgbụgba ndụ ọhụrụ na ụmụ mmadụ
Ọmụmụ ọrụ ebube nye ndị ya
Alaeze e guzobere maka usoro ọmụmụ ya
Nlaghachi nye ndị ya bụ ndị kwere n'oge ahụ
Mmeri megide onye ọchịchị aka ike
outcome.answer: Nlaghachi nye ndị ya bụ ndị kwere n'oge ahụ

verse: And [mention] Dhun-Nun, when he went off in anger and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him. But he called out within the darknesses, 'There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.' (Al-Anbiya 21:87)
arabic: وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَٰضِبًا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
